title: Scope reduction — Cloud platform / infrastructure
transcript:
Platform Engineering Lead: Alright everyone, let's dive into the cloud migration plan. We've been discussing our options for some time now.

SRE: I wanted to start by saying that I have concerns about the long-term viability of our current infrastructure, given the increased technical debt.

Finance Partner: Understood, but we need to consider the financial implications as well. Migrating to AWS provides feature parity and reduces technical debt over time, but comes with an upfront cost.

CTO: Let's not forget about the ongoing data privacy investigation. We need to take that into account when making our decision.

Platform Engineering Lead: That's right. Azure's partial migration could potentially address data privacy concerns while still addressing immediate infrastructure needs, but it may not provide the full solution we need.

SRE: I agree. Shifting to Google Cloud Platform with a two-month extension for compliance would be unacceptable given the impact on our game's release date.

CTO: I propose we maintain the status quo for now, with a temporary cloud platform freeze to address data privacy concerns.

Finance Partner: I see your point, CTO. Maintaining the current infrastructure minimizes the risk of further data-privacy issues during the ongoing investigation.

Platform Engineering Lead: And, it's less complicated than transitioning to a new cloud platform, which would require additional training and transition time for our team.

SRE: (sighs) I understand the reasoning, but I still have reservations about the technical debt we're accruing.

CTO: Those are valid concerns, SRE. We'll need to keep a close eye on it and make adjustments as necessary. But for now, we need to focus on ensuring our data privacy measures are in place by the end of May.

Finance Partner: Agreed. We'll also need a contingency plan for data privacy while the investigation continues.

Platform Engineering Lead: I'll work with the team to develop that plan. SRE, you'll own this issue moving forward.

(off-topic exchange)

SRE: By the way, I heard the game's art team is throwing a pizza party next Friday. Anyone who wants to join, just let me know.

CTO: Sounds like fun. I'll be there.

Platform Engineering Lead: Count me in as well.

(back to the topic)

CTO: Alright, with that said, I'm signing off on the temporary cloud platform freeze. Let's regroup next week to discuss any progress made on the contingency plan.

All: Understood.

(end of meeting)
document:
Title: SRE Meeting Summary

The SRE meeting discussed the team's familiarity with Azure and AWS, highlighting the need for additional training and transition time due to their less-frequent use.

Consideration was given to various options for cloud platform migration, including Google Cloud Platform, Azure, AWS, and maintaining the current infrastructure. A decision on the best course of action was postponed pending further investigation into data privacy concerns.

The SRE raised concerns about increased technical debt and the long-term viability of the current infrastructure. A contingency plan for data privacy will be put in place while the investigation continues. The team will focus on addressing immediate infrastructure needs in the meantime. The CTO will provide further updates as the situation progresses.
